about_the_game:
A first-person walking sim horror/character drama, where five unlucky graduates find themselves stranded in an abandoned forest cabin.

Of course, you already know the end- none of them make it there alive. Everything seemed good at first, good ol' Alice taking the lead, marching everyone toward survival. Friendly Harper is there to lend a hand, little Emma doing her damnedest to not go insane, and funny ol' Jordan there to make sure that everyone smiles and has a good time.

We don't talk about Marcus.

You shouldn't talk about Marcus.

Discover the Truth

However, you are not one of the plucky young souls doomed to die. You are The Apprentice of The Arbitrator, an ethereal being tasked with sending everyone to either a second chance at life, or complete and total oblivion. That's where you come in- this is a very, very special case, and they need you to take over... at least for now.

View their final days

In order to make your judgements, you view the final days of their horrid lives to fully determine their fates. Unfortunately, the memories of these five are scrambled and out of order- so it's up to you to put the pieces together and figure it out yourself.

And remember...

Everything is going to be just fine.

content_descriptors.notes: Low poly depictions of death, mentions of sex and sexual violence, underage drinking, homophobia
